Name: FlowerDance - More softly rejection (RU)
Author: gwynethgrayson
Description:
More softly rejections from the valley dwellers. Not too sweet, but quite friendly.
(Except maybe Shane and Sebastian. What do we consider friendliness anyway?
Let's just say my farmer won't leave the dances in tears now, and I hope your farmer too.)

Only russian language here, becouse my english literraly bad, but you can translate this mod at any another language, if you want it.
(Should I try to make an english version for preview?)

[s]I play in version 1.6.8 and I don't know how this mod will work in later versions :?
[/s]Okay, it work for 1.6.15, how can i see :?
